name: Digent Smart AI – Connect Sites to Claude & ChatGPT via MCP Server
author: amanstacker

sections.description:
Make your WordPress site AI-ready with Digent Smart AI. Connect Claude and ChatGPT to your WordPress site through official Model Context Protocol (MCP) and the native WordPress Abilities API. Let your AI assistant manage posts, update content, work with site data, audit SEO, and execute supported WordPress actions—all through natural-language instructions.

Home | Documentation | Claude MCP Guide | ChatGPT MCP Guide | Help & Support | Upgrade

Forget manual copy-pasting and constant tab switching. Manage your WordPress site directly through your AI assistant using simple, natural-language commands. From designing landing pages and styling headers to managing WooCommerce products, running flash sales, optimizing SEO, and managing content—get things done faster with precision, cryptographic security, and human-controlled safeguards.

Official Supported AI Connectors

  • Claude Custom MCP (claude.ai): Connect Claude directly to your WordPress site in 60 seconds with official MCP, auto OAuth detection, and instant 6-digit OTP email verification. Available on Free, Pro, and Team tiers.
    👉 Read Illustrated Claude MCP Guide

  • ChatGPT Custom MCP (chatgpt.com): Connect ChatGPT directly to your WordPress site using Model Context Protocol (MCP) Streamable HTTP with OAuth authentication.
    👉 Read Illustrated ChatGPT MCP Guide

Key Features

Zero Coding Required (No-Code AI Automation)

  • Talk to Your Website in Plain English: Chat with ChatGPT or Claude just like talking to an experienced webmaster. Tell your AI what to write, design, update, or clean up—no confusing menus or endless tab switching.
  • No-Code Website & Page Design: Design responsive landing pages, hero banners, headers, footers, and sidebars simply by describing what you want. Automatically structure layouts with Gutenberg blocks, adjust styling, and assign full-width templates without touching code.
  • WooCommerce E-Commerce Assistant: Manage your WooCommerce store hands-free. Ask your AI to create products, craft persuasive descriptions, set regular and sale prices, assign categories, and check low-stock inventory.
  • Elementor & Page Builder Ready: Seamlessly works alongside top builders like Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, and Beaver Builder. Set page templates (e.g. Elementor Canvas, Full Width, Blank Canvas), inject custom CSS tweaks, and scaffold layouts ready for visual editing.
  • Effortless Hands-Free Publishing: Turn your notes, transcripts, or ideas into fully formatted WordPress articles and pages with Gutenberg blocks, headings, categories, tags, and excerpts automatically configured.
  • Automated Hands-Off SEO: Connects directly with Rank Math SEO and Yoast SEO. Ask your AI to review your articles, craft compelling meta titles and descriptions, and assign high-impact focus keywords in seconds.
  • Simple, Jargon-Free Site Health Check: Ask your AI assistant “Is my website running smoothly?” and receive a clear, easy-to-understand health report highlighting storage, updates, and performance tips without confusing technical jargon.
  • 1-Click Database & Spam Cleanup: Ask AI to safely sweep away thousands of old post revisions, auto-drafts, and spam comments to speed up your website—no complex database tools or technical knowledge needed.
  • Fast Comment Moderation: Ask your AI to review pending comments, weed out unwanted spam links, and approve genuine discussions hands-free.
  • Instant Subscriber Push Notifications: Tell your AI to compose and broadcast web push alerts to your subscribers whenever you release a new article or announce a sale.
  • 1-Click Cloud Setup: Connect your site to Claude or ChatGPT in under 30 seconds. No server configuration, terminal commands, or complex coding required.
  • Dual Foundation: Native support for the Anthropic Model Context Protocol (MCP) and the WordPress Core Abilities API (wp_register_ability).
  • 7 High-Efficiency Operational Engines: Streamlined toolset covering Content, Theme Files, in-memory CLI Bridge, Diagnostics, Universal SEO, Web Push Campaigns, and Crash-Proof Code Snippets.
  • Dual-Transport Architecture: High-speed Stateless HTTP (/wp-json/digent-smart-ai/v1/mcp) and Real-time Streaming Server-Sent Events SSE (/wp-json/digent-smart-ai/v1/mcp/sse).
  • Hybrid Connectivity: Use the 1-Click Central SaaS Cloud Gateway (https://digentsmartai.com) for site connection, remote proxying, and HMAC SHA-256 signatures.
  • Zero Database Bloat: Real-time telemetry, execution latency tracking, and audit trails are streamed to your Cloud Gateway without filling up local WordPress database tables.

What You Can Do in Plain English (Real-World Examples)

You do not need to be a developer to use Digent Smart AI. Once connected, open Claude or ChatGPT and simply ask:

  • Publish New Articles: “Draft a comprehensive beginner’s guide on ‘Indoor Plant Care’ with headings and bullet points, assign it to the Lifestyle category, and save it as a draft.”
  • Audit & Fix SEO: “Review my 5 latest published blog posts, check their Rank Math or Yoast SEO scores, and optimize any missing meta titles, descriptions, and focus keywords.”
  • Design High-Converting Landing Pages: “Design a modern landing page for my consulting service with a hero headline, 3-column benefits grid, testimonials block, pricing table, and FAQ accordion using clean Gutenberg blocks.”
  • Elementor Canvas & Template Setup: “Create a clean promotional sales page, set its layout template to ‘Elementor Canvas’ so it has no header or footer distractions, and make it our active homepage.”
  • Header, Footer & Sidebar Styling: “Add custom CSS to make the header sticky with a frosted glass effect, style sidebar widgets with subtle rounded borders, and give call-to-action buttons a hover transition.”
  • Add WooCommerce Products: “Add a new WooCommerce product called ‘Wireless Noise-Canceling Headphones’, set regular price to $149 and sale price to $119, write an engaging 250-word description with specs, and assign it to Electronics.”
  • WooCommerce Flash Sales & Price Updates: “Put all products in the ‘Summer Apparel’ category on a 15% discount for our weekend flash sale and schedule an announcement push notification.”
  • Store Inventory & Product Audit: “Audit my WooCommerce store: are there any products currently out of stock or low in inventory, and what is our best-selling item this month?”
  • Create Pages & Set Homepage: “Create an ‘About Our Team’ page with our company mission, story, and contact info, and publish it with a clean layout.”
  • Clean Database Junk: “Clean up my site’s database by safely deleting all spam comments, auto-drafts, and old post revisions to keep things fast.”
  • Site Health & Update Check: “Give me a quick health checkup on my site: are there any plugins needing updates, what PHP version is running, and is my site health good?”
  • Moderate Comments Hands-Free: “Scan all pending comments, trash any obvious spam with suspicious links, and let me know how many genuine comments are left.”
  • Broadcast Web Push Alerts: “Compose an engaging push notification announcing our weekend discount with a link to our store, and send it to all subscribers.”
  • Organize Categories & Tags: “Create 4 new categories for our blog: AI News, Tutorials, Case Studies, and Reviews, and reorganize my recent drafts.”
  • Write Social Excerpts: “Read my top 5 published articles and generate compelling 2-sentence excerpts so they look great when shared on social media.”
  • Find Outdated Content: “List all blog posts published more than 2 years ago so I can review which ones need a content refresh.”

Connect Claude to WordPress

Connect Claude (claude.ai) directly to your live WordPress site in under 60 seconds using the official Model Context Protocol (MCP). Digent Smart AI supports Claude Free, Pro, and Team accounts with zero local command-line tools needed.

👉 Illustrated Claude Setup Guide

Once connected, ask Claude to:
* Draft and publish comprehensive blog posts with rich Gutenberg block structures.
* Design landing pages, hero layouts, and assign Elementor Canvas or full-width page templates.
* Manage WooCommerce products, create promotional landing pages, and update store pricing.
* Reorganize site taxonomy, categories, tags, and custom metadata.
* Perform a site-wide content refresh or bulk update publish dates.
* Inspect site health diagnostics and suggest architectural optimizations.

Claude sees your WordPress site through the standardized MCP bridge and takes direct action through safe, verified tool calls.

Connect ChatGPT to WordPress

Connect ChatGPT (chatgpt.com) directly to your WordPress site without fragile third-party wrappers. With ChatGPT’s direct support for Custom MCP servers, your conversations gain full read-and-write capabilities on WordPress.

👉 Illustrated ChatGPT Setup Guide

Ask ChatGPT to:
* Turn research notes, outlines, or Google Docs into polished WordPress articles with featured images and excerpt metadata.
* Audit your top 20 pages for SEO gaps and automatically optimize meta titles, meta descriptions, and focus keywords.
* Moderate user comments, bulk-delete spam, and adjust discussion settings.
* Dispatch web push campaign notifications to your subscribers via HyperPush-X and Hyper-PWA integration.
* Create and update WooCommerce products, set sale prices, and check inventory stock levels.
* Inject custom CSS styling to personalize headers, footers, and sidebars without touching theme code.

Native WordPress Abilities API Support

WordPress Core introduced the Abilities API (wp_register_ability), providing a standard framework for plugins to declare self-describing operations that AI agents can discover and execute natively.

Digent Smart AI is a first-class citizen of the Abilities ecosystem:
* All 7 operational engines automatically register under the dgnts-ai ability category whenever the Abilities API is present in your WordPress environment.
* Features standardized JSON Schema definitions, user capability callbacks, and full REST schema reflection.
* Guarantees forward compatibility with upcoming WordPress core AI and agentic features.

7 Unified Generic Operational Engines

Instead of cluttering your AI client’s context window with dozens of fragmented micro-tools, Digent Smart AI uses a consolidated, high-efficiency engine architecture inspired by modern agentic design:

  1. wp_content: Complete content engine for posts, pages, custom post types, Gutenberg block layouts, categories, tags, template assignments, and custom fields.
  2. wp_files: Secure file and theme manager for reading, writing, and searching active theme and child theme files, plus custom CSS injection with automatic rollback backups.
  3. wp_cli_run: In-memory administrative bridge executing WordPress management tasks (plugins, themes, users, options, transient cleanups, database optimizations, and spam moderation) without OS shell access.
  4. wp_site_info: Comprehensive diagnostic engine providing environment telemetry, PHP configuration, database metrics, active plugins, theme status, and security posture.
  5. wp_seo: Universal search engine optimization engine with native two-way integration for Rank Math and Yoast SEO (meta tags, focus keywords, sitemaps, indexing controls, and audits).
  6. wp_campaign: Automated web push campaign dispatcher integrated with HyperPush-X and Hyper-PWA, allowing AI agents to broadcast push notifications to subscribers.
  7. wp_snippets: Isolated, crash-proof code snippet manager operating in mu-plugins with syntax validation and instant error containment.

Real-time Context Resources & Production Prompts

Digent Smart AI implements the full 2024-11-05 Model Context Protocol specification:

MCP Resources:
* wordpress://site-overview: High-level summary of site identity, WordPress version, active theme, and content stats.
* wordpress://site-health: Live diagnostic telemetry, PHP limits, database engine, and memory usage.
* wordpress://content-schema: Dynamic schema of all public post types, taxonomies, and registered metadata.
* wordpress://plugins-list: Complete inventory of installed, active, and update-pending plugins.

MCP Prompt Templates:
* content-writer: Production prompt for drafting SEO-optimized articles with Gutenberg block layout structures.
* seo-optimizer: Deep-dive audit prompt for optimizing headings, meta descriptions, and keyword density.
* site-audit: Comprehensive performance, security, and plugin conflict diagnostic prompt.

Enterprise Security, Privacy & Guardrails

Giving AI agents access to your website demands uncompromising security. Digent Smart AI is engineered with rigorous enterprise safety guardrails:

  • Granular Capability Checks: Every operation enforces native WordPress permissions (edit_posts, manage_options, moderate_comments). An agent cannot perform actions beyond the authenticated user’s permissions.
  • Dual Authentication Modes: Authenticate locally with WordPress Application Passwords or remotely via encrypted HMAC SHA-256 tokens (X-Dgnts-Signature, X-Dgnts-Timestamp) through the Digent Cloud Gateway.
  • No Shell Execution: The wp_cli_run engine operates strictly in-memory using internal WordPress APIs. Dangerous PHP functions like shell_exec(), exec(), and system() are never used.
  • Automatic Rollback Backups: Before modifying any theme file or code snippet, a timestamped snapshot is saved in wp-content/digent-smart-ai-backups/, ensuring instant recovery.
  • Syntax Validation & Error Trapping: All code snippets and theme edits undergo PHP tokenization and syntax linting before being written to disk.
  • Zero Database Bloat: Connection logs and AI interaction telemetry are routed to your Cloud Gateway dashboard rather than cluttering your WordPress database with millions of transient log rows.

Support & Documentation

For help, documentation, and tutorials, visit our official website:

Knowledge Base
Help & Support

Credits

Digent Smart AI is built with open web and AI standards, incorporating concepts and specifications from:

  1. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Specification – Open standard for connecting AI assistants to data systems by Anthropic.

    • Link: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol
    • License: MIT

  2. JSON-RPC 2.0 Specification – Standardized stateless remote procedure call protocol.

    • Link: https://www.jsonrpc.org/specification
    • License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0

External Services

Digent Smart AI connects to external services to deliver cloud AI gateway routing, core integrity verification:

  1. Digent Smart AI Cloud Gateway (https://digentsmartai.com)
    • Service Description: Provides secure cloud MCP relay routing for web AI clients (ChatGPT, Claude Web), multi-site AI orchestration, telemetry latency tracking, and centralized caching of WordPress core release checksums for rapid malware analysis.
    • Data Transmitted: When paired with the Cloud Gateway, your website communicates its public URL, site name, plugin version, and incoming MCP tool execution requests authenticated via cryptographic HMAC SHA-256 signatures. For security checksum verification, only the WordPress core version (e.g. 6.7.1) and locale are queried. Zero private user data, post content, or passwords are transmitted.
    • Terms of Service: https://digentsmartai.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://digentsmartai.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1-Click Cloud Connect (Recommended)

  1. Upload the digent-smart-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. In your WordPress admin menu, click on Digent Smart AI.
  4. Click Connect to Cloud Gateway (1-Click Sync).
  5. Once paired, copy your Cloud MCP Endpoint URL (https://digentsmartai.com/mcp).
  6. Connect your preferred AI assistant:
    • For Claude: Follow the Claude Setup Guide
    • For ChatGPT: Follow the ChatGPT Setup Guide
sections.faq:
What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard introduced by Anthropic that allows AI models (like Claude and ChatGPT) to securely connect to external data sources and execution tools through a unified JSON-RPC protocol. Digent Smart AI turns your WordPress site into a fully compliant MCP server.

What is the WordPress Abilities API?

The Abilities API (wp_register_ability) is the WordPress Core framework allowing plugins and themes to expose structured, machine-discoverable operations to autonomous AI agents. Digent Smart AI natively registers all operational engines as Core Abilities with input schema validation and permission checks.

Can an AI assistant crash my website?

No. Digent Smart AI incorporates multi-layer safety protections:
1. All file modifications and code snippets undergo pre-write PHP syntax checks.
2. Automatic file snapshots are stored in wp-content/digent-smart-ai-backups/ prior to any modification.
3. Snippets run inside an isolated mu-plugin with catch-and-contain error handling.
4. In-memory CLI commands reject arbitrary destructive queries.

Does this plugin require shell access or WP-CLI installed on my server?

No. Digent Smart AI does not require OS-level shell access or the WP-CLI binary. The wp_cli_run engine operates strictly in-memory using native WordPress internal APIs, making it 100% compatible with shared hosting, managed WordPress hosts, VPS, and cloud containers.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

Digent Smart AI provides deep two-way integration for both Rank Math SEO and Yoast SEO. Your AI agent can read current SEO scores, analyze focus keywords, update canonical URLs, toggle robots noindex directives, and optimize meta titles and descriptions.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

Digent Smart AI includes a clean uninstall.php handler. If you delete the plugin, all stored connection options, temporary transients, cached telemetry, and mu-plugin snippet files are cleanly purged according to WordPress VIP standards, leaving zero orphan data in your database.

Can I use Digent Smart AI across multiple WordPress sites?

Yes! Using the Digent Smart AI Cloud Gateway (https://digentsmartai.com), agencies and site owners can manage multiple WordPress sites from a single centralized dashboard, rotating access tokens and routing AI prompts to different sites on demand.

  • Dual Authentication Modes: Authenticate locally with WordPress Application Passwords or remotely via encrypted HMAC SHA-256 tokens (X-Dgnts-Signature, X-Dgnts-Timestamp) through the Digent Cloud Gateway.
  • No Shell Execution: The wp_cli_run engine operates strictly in-memory using internal WordPress APIs. Dangerous PHP functions like shell_exec(), exec(), and system() are never used.
  • Automatic Rollback Backups: Before modifying any theme file or code snippet, a timestamped snapshot is saved in wp-content/digent-smart-ai-backups/, ensuring instant recovery.
  • Syntax Validation & Error Trapping: All code snippets and theme edits undergo PHP tokenization and syntax linting before being written to disk.
  • Zero Database Bloat: Connection logs and AI interaction telemetry are routed to your Cloud Gateway dashboard rather than cluttering your WordPress database with millions of transient log rows.
